{{Top|leg}}
The '''Colonial Government''' was the official ruling body on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Officially, under the terms of the [[Interim Constitution]], the Colonial Government was an advisory body to the [[P'Dar'Ken]]. In reality, the Colonial Government was the true power on Goroth. The Colonial Government was headed by the [[Colonial Governor]], [[Marsh Limoth]], and divided into two branches – the executive branch and the administrative branch. The executive branch was headed by Governor Limoth, while the administrative branch was controlled by [[Director of Administration]] [[Crela Nen]]. [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] forces were led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Val DeGoort]] while [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] forces were commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anderton Kloff]].
